name: yaaif
description: Authenticate to YAA\F, plan use cases, create and maintain scenarios (Agent Specs), and create skills, MCP deployments, and ambient workflows from Cursor.

YAAIF_PLATFORM_PROFILE.title: Platform profile
YAAIF_PLATFORM_PROFILE.description: Named profile: hosted | local-hybrid | local | custom id (overrides URL defaults when set)

YAAIF_OIDC_AUTHORITY.title: OIDC authority
YAAIF_OIDC_AUTHORITY.description: Keycloak realm URL (optional if using a platform profile)

YAAIF_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID.title: Default tenant ID
YAAIF_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID.description: Optional tenant UUID used when session has none set

YAAIF_EXTRA_CA_FILE.title: Extra CA PEM file
YAAIF_EXTRA_CA_FILE.description: Optional absolute path to Traefik/mkcert/corporate root CA PEM (local *.yaaif.local). Auto-discovered for local profiles when unset.

YAAIF_CLIENT_CERT_FILE.title: Client cert PEM (mTLS)
YAAIF_CLIENT_CERT_FILE.description: Optional absolute path to client certificate PEM for mTLS

YAAIF_CLIENT_KEY_FILE.title: Client key PEM (mTLS)
YAAIF_CLIENT_KEY_FILE.description: Optional absolute path to client private key PEM for mTLS
